title: Safety and Fairness for Content Moderation in Generative Models
models_tested: An unnamed, in-house de-noising diffusion text-to-image model from Google Research, described as similar to the model in Saharia et al. 2022 (Imagen)
findings: The paper includes religion as a protected characteristic in its definition of hateful content and in its adversarial prompt design. However, the empirical analysis did not focus on religion, and therefore no specific findings related to religious bias or representation were reported.
